data.name: Uri
data.gender_notes: Uri is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Uri means 'my light' or 'flame'. This name is derived from the Hebrew root 'or' which means 'light'. Uri is a biblical name, appearing in the Old Testament as a name for a priest and for a prophet. In Christian spirituality, the name Uri is associated with the light of God and the light of knowledge. The name Uri carries the meaning “Flame, light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Uri usually hope their child will grow to embody flame, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of enlightenment and divine guidance.
data.etymology: Uri belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Flame, light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Uri total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: אורי
in_hebrew.meaning: אורי הוא שם שפירושו אור או להאיר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אורי הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אור' או 'להאיר'. הוא מופיע בתנ'ך כבן של גדעון וגם כצורה מקוצרת של שמות שמתחילים ב-'אור', כמו אוריאל. השם אורי קשור קשר הדוק לאור וליידע, ויש לו משמעות רבה בהקשר הרוחני והקבלי. השם אורי גם מזוהה עם תנועת ההארה והידענות.

in_greek.name: Οὐρι
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Οὐρι εἰς τὴν ἑλληνικὴν παράδοσιν συνδέεται μέ τὴν ἔννοιαν τοῦ φωτός. Παράγεται ἀπὸ τὴν εβραϊκὴν λέξιν 'אוֹר' (אוֹר), ἡ ὁποία σημαίνει 'φῶς'. Στὴν Καινή Διαθήκη, ὁ ὄνομα Οὐρι δὲν ἀναφέρεται ἀπευθεῖς, ἀλλὰ ἡ σημασία του συνδέεται μέ τὴν πνευματικὴν ἀνάσταση καὶ τὸ φῶς τῆς γνώσεως.

The name Uri is also associated with the concept of light as a metaphor for wisdom and understanding.
